about: Audio and captions are copyrighted YouTube content: scripts/fetch-baseline-clips.ps1 caches them under bench-runs/baseline-cache/ (gitignored). Never commit them.

tolerance.wer_pp gates WER relative to expected.wer_pct (absolute percentage points, either way). speakers_min/max, max_repeat_run and max_repeated_segments are absolute bounds. RTF and timings are machine-dependent and never gated.
expected is rewritten by `bench_cli baseline --update`. Run that only when a change is an intentional improvement.

known_failures (optional) lists gated metrics already known to fail on a clip: wer, speakers, longest_repeat_run, repeated_segments, minutes. They report KNOWN without failing the run, and FIXED once they pass, at which point remove the entry. Never widen a tolerance to hide a failure; list it here instead.
caption_language (optional, default English) is the language of the caption text, e.g. ta. caption_track must be a human-made subtitle track (yt-dlp --write-subs), never YouTube's automatic captions.

clips.title: KIII 3 News: Alice city council holds tense meeting
clips.what_it_tests: Multi-speaker real council-room audio (reverberant room mics, distant talkers) cut with broadcast studio and reporter narration: diarization over-splitting and STT on far-field speech.
clips.caption_quality: Broadcast live captions: ALL CAPS, non-verbatim (paraphrased, words dropped), cues not duplicated. WER here is an upper bound on the real error rate; use it for regressions, not as an absolute accuracy figure.

recorded.how: hand-measured with bench_cli compare --variants raw,shipped --reference <captions> (shipped row; raw front end gave 16.1% WER, 9 speakers); working tree had uncommitted edits

clips.title: TED: Celeste Headlee, 10 ways to have a better conversation
clips.what_it_tests: One practised speaker on a stage mic for ~12 minutes, with audience laughter and applause: long-form STT accuracy, whisper looping on a long recording, and diarization over-splitting a single talker (the known failure mode the speaker bound exists to catch).
clips.caption_quality: Professional TED captions, close to verbatim. Sound annotations such as (Laughter) and (Applause) are dropped by the VTT parser.

recorded.how: copied by hand from bench-runs/20261006-030726-baseline (bench_cli baseline, no --with-mom; i7-1260P) without re-running; WER 54/1950, longest repeat 2x "i came to realize"; stages preprocess 93.7s, denoise 91.7s, VAD 7.8s, diarization 143.3s, STT 587.1s, align 0.0s; working tree had uncommitted edits (align island fix, hybrid LLM thread rule, retired-model detection). speakers=8 is a KNOWN FAILURE against the 1-2 bound: diarization over-splits one talker (roadmap risks 12/18). The bound stays as the target; do not widen it.
